description: Object /views (spec 19.13 Views): what the statusline and the buffer to project lookup need of the workspace's projects, nothing of the status page. get returns the full state; update, declared initial, carries the full state again whenever it changed (a unit's state change, never a build's progress), never a delta. The editor builds the same shape in-process without the ids.

get.description: The view's full state. Never loads the workspace: an unloaded one has no projects.

update.description: The view's full state, sent after a model segment or a committed write that changed it (before the acknowledgement of the command that caused the change), only when it differs from the state last sent on the subscription.

projects.description: One record per project of the workspace, ordered by key; empty when the workspace is not loaded.

id.description: The project's opaque id (spec 19.12): always sent by the daemon, absent in-process.

label.description: The project's display text: its key (a project has no display name of its own). Clients show it, never derive it.

type.description: The project's module type (cmake, meson, ...); a project of an unknown or rejected type is listed with its declared type and without active.

path.description: The project's directory relative to the workspace root, /-separated: its declared path, or its key when it declares none.

abs_path.description: The workspace root joined with path, absolute and /-separated, as the daemon resolves it (not case-folded).

active.description: Present when the active profile maps the project.

configuration.description: The name of the project's configuration in the active profile.

unit_id.description: The opaque id of the configuration unit for that configuration and tool; absent when the profile has no unit for the project yet, and always in-process.

tool_key.description: The key of that configuration's tool; absent for a module whose single toolchain has none.

state.description: The configuration unit's state (state-lifecycle 3.4); unconfigured when the profile has no unit for the project yet. Includes a task another client runs in the daemon. Clients show an unknown state as neutral.
